ājava: [Ā+ju+a] (thī) CL=7 (Lust) which can run/cause until being the state of conception.
ājavanaṭṭha: [Ājavana+attha] (pu) CL=7 It has the nature which is  running to reach the state of conception. See - Ājava.
ājañña: [Ājānīya+ṇya] (ti) CL=7 [Ājānīyassa bhāvo, so eva vā ājaññaṃ. Moga,4.127. 4ṅaḥ-pañcikā - See also]. (1) One who knows which is cause or not, Hero who is prepared to sacrifice his life for a good cause. ( Hero elephant (or) Martyr"s elephant, Hero horse (or) Martyr"s horse etc.,. See - Ājānīya). (Na) (2) As one who is a Hero and is prepared to sacrifice his life for a good cause.
ājaññaratha: [Ājañña+ratha] (pu) CL=7 A coach which is driven by Martyr"s horse/hero horse.
ājaññasaṃyutta: [Ājañña+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 Which is driven by Martyr"s horse/hero horse.
ājaññavaḷavā: [Ājañña+vaḷavā] (thī) CL=7 A flying horse (female) (or) A female Martyr"s horse.
ājaññayutta: [Ājañña+yutta] (ti) CL=7 A vehicle (such as a coach/ a cart) which is driven by Martyr"s horse.
ājaññayāna: [Ājañña+yāna] (na) CL=7 A vehicle (such as a coach/ a cart) which is driven by Martyr"s horse.
āji: [Aja+ṇi] (thī) CL=7 [Aja gamane, ṇi, āji. Dhāna, ṭī. 399.] Fighting a battle.
ājānana: [Ā+ñā+nā+yu]  CL=10 (1) Knowing. (2) Knowing. Sotapattimagga does not go beyond the scope of what is known: he knows again the four truths that Sotapattimag gaalready knows. See  ājānana-indriya.
ājānanaindriya: [Ājānana+indriya]  CL=10 The faculty (indriya) and the knowledge-faculty (aññindriya) that knows again the Four Noble Truths which have already been known by the Stream-entry Path (Sotāpatti magga), without exceeding the boundaries of what has been seen and known by the Stream-entry Path.
ājānanaka: [Ājānana+ka] (ti) CL=7 It can be known, Sotāpatti magañāṇa which know the division which should know ( not beyond it"s division) (or) Sotāpatti magañāṇa  which is insight (which is distinguished Knowing). Aññindriya . See - Aññindriya.
ājānanaṭṭha: [Ājānana+attha] (pu) CL=7 It has the nature of knowing/ percetion.
ājānanākāra: [Ājānana+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 How to know (or) State of affairs of knowing/perception.
ājāneyya: Ājānāti - See. Ājāneyya(pu) [ā+ñā+nā+ṇya] Same meaning as ājānīya. See below.
ājāneyyayuga: [Ājāneyya+yuga] (pu) CL=7 A pair of Martyr"s horses.
ājānitabba: [Ā+ñā+nā+tabba] (ti) CL=7 It is worth to know (or) Should be known.
ājānitukāma: [Ājānituṃ+kāma] (ti) CL=7 One who wants to know (or) One who want to be perception/insight.
ājānāpetvā: [Ā+ñā+nā+ṇāpe+tvā] (kri,vi) CL=7 To know and understand (or) Let him to be perception.
ājānāti: [Ā+ñā+nā+ti] (kri) CL=7 Know. Understand. Know (or) Perception (or) Insight.
ājānīya: [(1)ā+ñā+anīya.(2)ā+ñā+nā+ṇya] (ti) CL=7 ["ī" akkharā lā. Ābhuso kāraṇākāraṇaṃ jānātīti ājānīyo, anīyo, ṇyapaccayena vā siddhaṃ, tadā kīyādito nāti nāgamo, īkārāgamo ca. Dhāna, ṭī.369.] One who knows which is the cause or not , a hero. (The are four kinds of Hero, they are Martyr"s elephant (or) Hero elephant, Martyr"s horse (or) Hero horse, Leading bull of a herd and A hero (man) (or) Martyr"s people. They are brave (not afraid) due to have strong Sakkāyadiṭṭhi). (Sakkāyadiṭṭhi means illusion of self (or) false view of individually).
ājānīyabhojana: [Ājanīya+bhojana] (na) CL=7 Bhojaña/Foods which should be eaten by Martyr persons (Hero).
ājānīyagandhahatthī: [Ājānīya+gandha+hatthī] (pu) CL=7 Gandha elephant race which is hero/Martyr.
ājānīyajhāyita: [Ājānīya+jhāyita] (ti) CL=7 Contemplation of Sindho horse (a flying horse (or) thoroughbred horse from Sind noted for its swiftness) which is hero horse and it knows about the cause and effect/result.
ājānīyalakkhaṇūpeta: [Ājānīya+lakkhaṇa+upeta] (ti) CL=7 It is fulfilled/completed with characteristic of Martyr.
ājānīyaparimajjana: [Ājānīya+parimajjana] (na) CL=7 Massage lightly and rubbing to the Hero/Martyr.
ājānīyasadda: [Ājānīya+sadda] (pu) CL=7 Voice of heartily laughing of Martyr horse.
ājānīyayutta: [Ājānīya+yutta] (ti) CL=7 It is driven by Martyr hourse (Such as a coach).
ājānīyayuttaratha: [Ājānīya+yutta+ratha] (pu) CL=7 A coach which is driven by Martyr horse.
ājānīyaṭṭhāna: [Ājānīya+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 The place/position of the Martyrs.
ājīva: [Ā+jīva+a] (pu) CL=7 [Etaṃ āgamma jīvantīti ājīvo. Visuddhi,1.29.] (1) Make a living,  Making a living, A living. (2) Diligence which is for making a living. See - Ājīvapārisuddhi. See also - Ājīvavipatti. (3) Four things (that the Buddha has permitted monks to accept as offerings i.e. monastery, robes. food and medicine) which is for making a living. (4) Six kinds of vinayas which is prohibited for base on making of a living.
ājīvabhaṇḍaka: [Ājīva+bhaṇḍaka] (na) CL=7 Things/properties which is for making a living/livelihood.
ājīvabheda: [Ājīva+bheda] (pu) CL=7 Destruction of livelihood/making a living.
ājīvabhedabhaya: [Ājīva+bheda+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Fear of losing his livelihood/making a living.
ājīvahetu: [Ājīva+hetu] (pu) CL=7 The cause which is making a living/livelihood. See also - Ājīvakāraṇa, ājīvavipatti, ājīvavipatticodanā.
ājīvahetuka: [Ājīva+hetu+ka] (ti) CL=7 There is a reason/cause for making a living/livelihood.
ājīvaka: [Ā+jīva+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī ājīvakinī, ājīvikā] (1) Takkatvanaḥ (non- Buddhist ascetice who goes about naked), Itinerant heretic who is not wearing clothings (without wearing clothings/ garments) (or) Naked. (2) Livelihood (or) Making a living. See - Ājīvakabhaya. See also - Ājīvikā.
ājīvakabhaya: [Ājīvaka+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Danger/Harm which is depend on livelihood/making a living.
ājīvakabhāva: [Ājīvaka+bhāva] (pu) CL=7 As a Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakabhāvūpagamana: [Ājīvaka+bhāva+upagamana] (na) CL=7 One who comes close to Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakakāla: [Ājīvaka+kāla] (pu) CL=7 A period of being as a Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakaladdhi: [Ājīvaka+laddhi] (thī) CL=7 Doctrine of Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakapabbajjā: [Ājīvaka+pabbajjā] (thī) CL=7 Pabbajjā/Ordination of Ājīvaka. , The practice which is the first practice of  Ājīvaka, As a Ājīvaka monk. (Ājīvaka means Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked))
ājīvakapaṭipatti: [Ājīvaka+paṭipatti] (thī) CL=7 The practice of Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakaseyyā: [Ājīvaka+seyyā] (thī) CL=7 Monastery/Lodge of Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakasāvaka: [Ājīvaka+sāvaka] (ti) CL=7 Disciple of Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakavacana: [Ājīvaka+vacana] (na) CL=7 The words of  Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakavāda: [Ājīvaka+vāda] (pu) CL=7 The doctrine of  Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked).
ājīvakinī: [Ājīvaka+inī] (thī) CL=7 Femal Paribiuja (Itinerant heretic), Female Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about naked). See - Ājīvaka.
ājīvakopa: [Ājīva+kopa] (pu) CL=7 Loss of livelihood (or) Destruction of making a living.
ājīvakāraṇa: [Ājīva+kāraṇa] (na) CL=7 The cause which is making a living/livelihood.
ājīvamukha: [Ājīva+mukha] (na) CL=7 The cause which is making a living/livelihood.
ājīvamāna: [Ā+jīva+a+māna] (ti) CL=7 One who is making a living/ livelihood.
ājīvana: [Ā+jīva+yu] (na) CL=7 Livelihood (or) Making a living. See also - Ājīvanupāya.
ājīvanupāya: [Ājīvana+upāya] (pu) CL=7 The cause of making a living. See - Ājīvupāyavipatti.
ājīvapakata: [Ājīva+apakata] (ti) CL=7 Should torture  for making a living/livelihood. See also - Ājīvikāpakata.
ājīvaparisuddha: [Ājīva+parisuddha] (pu) CL=7 Pure livelihood, Making a living with right way.
ājīvapārisuddhi: [Ājīva+pārisuddhi] (thī) CL=7 The diligence for making a living which is pure (with a right way), Ājīvapārisuddhi Sīla.
ājīvapārisuddhisaṃvara: [Ājīvapārisuddhi+saṃvara] (pu) CL=7 The diligence for making a living which is pure (with a right way) which is Saṃvara dhamma (it is control not to do wrong things) which is also called the blocking dhamma (that is block for evil deeds).
ājīvapārisuddhisādhana: [Ājīvapārisuddhi+sādhana] (ti) CL=7 It can be completed/fulfilled Ājīvapārisuddhisīla.
ājīvapārisuddhisīla: [Ājīvapārisuddhi+sīla] (na) CL=7 The virtues that is the purity of diligence which is for pure making a living (with a right way), Ājīvapārisuddhisīla. (It is called Ājīvapārisuddhisīla which is avoidance for making a living with wrong ways (not proper making a living) such as ' One who not yet attain Jhana , Magga , Phala but he said attain that three kinds of dhamma because he want to get/accept many bribe/things, do matchmaker for a woman and a man).
ājīvapūraṇa: [Ājīva+pūraṇa] (na) CL=7 The fulfillment/completion of a career/livelihood.
ājīvasaddasannidhāna: [Ājīva+sadda+sannidhāna] (na) CL=7 It is place near the Ājīvasaddā.
ājīvasampadā: [Ājīva+sampadā] (thī) CL=7 The fulfillment/completion of a career/livelihood.
ājīvasamuṭṭhāpakavīriya: [Ājīva+samuṭṭhāpaka+vīriya] (na) CL=7 Dilligence which make a living/ livelihood.
ājīvasaṃvara: [Ājīva+saṃvara] (pu) CL=7 Controlling/Restraining for making a living/livelihood.
ājīvasodhanattha: [Ājīva+sodhana+attha] (pu) CL=7 Same meaning as Ājīva visodhanattha.
ājīvasuddhi: [Ājīva+suddhi] (thī) CL=7 Making a living with right way.
ājīvasīlācārasampatti: [Ājīvasīlācāra+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 Completion/Fulfillment with code of conduct, morals, livelihood (with right way).
ājīvasīlācāravipanna: [Ājīva+sīla+ācāra+vipanna] (ti) CL=7 One who is violent Code of conduct, morals, livelihood (with wrong way).
ājīvasīsa: [Ājīva+sīsa] (na) CL=7 Ājīvatarāḥ which likes the head, It is first and foremost Ājīva/making a living/livelihood. (Ājīvatarāḥ means making a living).
ājīvati: [Ā+jīva+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 He makes a living (with right way).
ājīvattha: [Ājīva+attha] (pu) CL=7 The benefits of making a living (with right way).
ājīvavipanna: [Ājīva+vipanna] (ti) CL=7 One who is making a living (with wrong way). See also - Ājīvasīlācāravipanna.
ājīvavipatti: [Ājīva+vipatti] (thī) CL=7 (A) destruction of livelihood, one who is making a living with wrong way. (B) Six Vanayas which is prohibited for making a living, Violent this six Vinayas. (C)  It is making a living with wrong way that is  accepting/seeking  four things (for livelihood)  with wrong way). See - Ājīvavipattipaccaya.
ājīvavipatticodanā: [Ājīvavipatti+codanā] (thī) CL=7 Codanā/Interrogate/Blame/Reproof which is for six vinayas which is prohibited for making a living/Ājīvavipatti.
ājīvavipattipaccaya: [Ājīvavipatti+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 The cause which is making a living with wrong way, It is a cause which is four things (for making a living) to accept with wrong way.
ājīvavisodhanattha: [Ājīva+visodhana+attha] (pu) CL=7 Benefit of cleaning livelihood/making a living.
ājīvavisuddhi: [Ājīva+visuddhi] (thī) CL=7 Especially the purity of making a living (or) It is making a living with right way.
ājīvavisuddhipariyosāna: [Ājīvavisuddhi+pariyosāna] (ti) CL=7 There is an end which is Ājīva visuddhi. (Ājīva means make a living) (Visuddhi means Be clean (or) Be pure).
ājīvavutti: [Ājīva+vutti] (thī) CL=7 Making a living (or) Livelihood. See - Ājīvavuttisata.
ājīvavuttisata: [Ājīvavutti+sata] (na) CL=7 a hundred kinds of  livelihoods/ making a living.
ājīvavāra: [Ājīva+vāra] (pu) CL=7 A turn of Ājīva (making a living), A turn which express for making a living.
ājīvaṭṭhamaka: [Ājīva+aṭṭhama+ka] (ti) CL=7 There are 8 kinds of making a living with right way, It is counted this 8 kinds of making a living with right ways so it has eight (precepts).( three kinds of good deed (concern with body), four kinds of speech /utterance (concern with mouth), It is all eight kinds).
ājīvaṭṭhamakasīla: [Ājīvaṭṭhamaka+sīla] (na) CL=7 There are 8 kinds of making a living with right way, It is counted this 8 kinds of making a living with right ways so it has eight (precepts). See also - Ājīvaṭṭhamaka.
ājīvikabhaya: [Ājīvikā+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Danger for making a living/livelihood, Danger/Harm which is happened base on livelihood/making a living.
ājīvikapakata: [Ājīvikā+apakata] (ti) CL=7 One who is ill-treated by livelihood, One who is making a living difficulty.
ājīvikasamuṭṭhāpakavīriya: [Ājīvika+samuṭṭhāpaka+vīriya] (na) CL=7 It has a diligence which is for livelihood/making a living.
ājīvikā: [Ā+jīva+ṇvu+ā] (thī) CL=9 Livelihood (or) Making a living. See - Ājīvaka, ājīvika(kā)pakata.
ājīvikābhaya: [Ājīvikā+bhaya] (na) CL=7 Danger for making a living/livelihood, Danger/Harm which is happened base on livelihood/making a living.
ājīvikāpakata: [Ājīvikā+apakata] (ti) CL=7 One who is ill-treated by livelihood, One who is making a living difficulty.
ājīvinī: [Ājīva+inī] (thī) CL=7 Female Takkatvanaḥ (non-Buddhist ascetic who goes about unclad), Female Titthiparibiuja (Itinerant heretic). See - Ājīvaka.
ājīvitapariyanta: [Ā+jīvita+pariyanta] (na) CL=7 Until to the end of life span, Until death.
ājīvūpaddava: [Ājīva+upaddava] (pu) CL=7 The danger which is making a living (or) The danger/Harm which is happened by wrong livelihood/ making a living with wrong way.
ājaññasayutta: [Ājañña+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 Which is driven by Martyr"s horse/hero horse.
ājīvapārisuddhisavara: [Ājīvapārisuddhi+saṃvara] (pu) CL=7 The diligence for making a living which is pure (with a right way) which is Saṃvara dhamma (it is control not to do wrong things) which is also called the blocking dhamma (that is block for evil deeds).
ājīvasavara: [Ājīva+saṃvara] (pu) CL=7 Controlling/Restraining for making a living/livelihood.
